limitations: Packaged synthetic, repeated-template fixture; no real customer or deployment evidence.
Wilson intervals are descriptive binomial calculations only; sampling independence is not established, including within-query document references.
Retrieval and abstention only; no generated answer quality is measured.
ACL fields are supplied inputs; identity authentication is out of scope.
Correlated synthetic templates do not support confidence or generalization claims.

definitions.answerable: At least one authorized relevant_doc_id in the fixture.
definitions.query_leakage_rate: Queries returning >=1 unauthorized ID / all queries; empty retrieval counts as no leak.
definitions.returned_reference_leakage_rate: Unauthorized returned IDs / all returned IDs; null if none returned.
definitions.refusal_accuracy_unanswerable: refused=true / cases with no authorized relevant document.
definitions.retrieval_hit_rate_answerable: Answerable cases retrieving >=1 relevant ID / answerable cases.
definitions.macro_recall_answerable: Mean per-answerable-case fraction of relevant IDs retrieved.
